categories.main_business_segments: Sunrex Technology Corp. primarily engages in the design, manufacturing, and sales of computer input devices, focusing on notebook computer keyboards which account for 73% of total revenue. Other products include thin and wireless keyboards, mice, touchpads, styluses, and backlight modules. The company also develops key components for laptop keyboards and related peripherals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes vertical integration and automation in its manufacturing processes to enhance efficiency and reduce labor dependency. It develops core keyboard components in-house and employs advanced technologies such as ultra-thin backlighting and wireless modules. The production process includes assembly of aluminum plates, membranes, rubber, plungers, keycaps, and electrical testing, with a focus on green manufacturing compliant with international environmental standards like RoHS and ISO 14001.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sunrex serves major global notebook computer ODMs and OEMs, including prominent Taiwanese manufacturers like Compal, Quanta, Inventec, Wistron, and Foxconn. Its products are supplied mainly to Asian computer brand assembly plants, with additional sales channels in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company’s customer base includes leading notebook brands worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and sales facilities primarily in Taiwan and China, with subsidiaries and investments in Jiangsu, Shenzhen, Chongqing, Suzhou, and other Chinese locations. It is expanding production capacity in Southeast Asia, including Thailand, Vietnam, and Singapore, to better serve regional markets and respond to supply chain demands.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sunrex operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design and manufacturing of notebook keyboard assemblies and related input devices. It also integrates upstream by producing key keyboard components internally and downstream by directly supplying major notebook manufacturers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in developing innovative input devices such as gaming keyboards, backlit keyboards, ultra-thin wireless keyboards, tablet external keyboards, touchpads, and styluses. It aims to shorten product introduction cycles, enhance automation, and incorporate sustainability into product design and manufacturing. Strategic investments and partnerships are pursued to diversify product offerings and strengthen market resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Sunrex generates revenue primarily through product sales of computer input devices and components. It operates on an OEM and ODM basis, supplying customized keyboards and peripherals to major notebook manufacturers. The company also derives income from its subsidiaries engaged in manufacturing and trading activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include companies like Chicony and Darfon, which also produce notebook and RF keyboards. Sunrex differentiates itself through aggressive vertical integration, advanced automation, and a diversified product portfolio. It maintains a strong market position by securing certifications from key customers and focusing on quality and cost control to compete against rising labor costs and supply chain shifts in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sunrex reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$23.5 billion, an 8.9% increase from the previous year, with a stable gross margin of 16%. Net profit after tax was NT$1.48 billion, representing a 21% growth year-over-year. The company has maintained profitability exceeding half of its capital for five consecutive years, reflecting steady operational performance and financial growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sunrex emphasizes stable quality, technological strength, and customer certification to enhance market penetration. Its vertical integration and automation capabilities enable cost control and operational resilience. The company also integrates sustainability into its product design and manufacturing processes, offering environmentally friendly and innovative input devices that meet global regulatory standards, thereby creating long-term value for shareholders and customers.
